name: Booking Page
summary: Share one short link to your calendar. People pick a free time and book a meeting, it lands on your ForkMesh calendar, and ForkMesh emails both of you the details.

screenshots.alt: A booking page with the host's name, meeting types, a month calendar with free days and a column of open times

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Booking
config.description: Your booking link, meeting types, weekly hours and the meetings people have booked.

permissions.label: Read your booking page settings and the meetings booked with you, encrypted under your account's own key
Change your booking link, meeting types and hours, and cancel meetings
Let anyone with your booking link see your free times and book a meeting with you
Check your ForkMesh calendar so busy times are never offered
Add booked meetings to your ForkMesh calendar and move or remove them when they change
Email confirmations, changes, cancellations and reminders to you and the person who booked
Ping you when someone books, moves or cancels a meeting
Add a Booking page to the desktop rail
